title: Transcript upload note into real Canva design
breadth_reason: state/stranger_breadth.json shows one verified CRM stranger and no verified canvas strangers, so this run broadens the rolling hard-category set with a real Canva user surface.

transcript_audit_policy.reason: The last transcript audit verdict is pass, so this script may use transcript_upload as the primary input while still observing audio and microphone proof gaps.

v7_target.engine: public downloadable user-device engine installed on the signed-in user's computer
v7_target.surface_rule: use the user's actual visible Chrome profile and Canva design surface; do not use cloned Chrome, copied profiles, hidden browser state, private install paths, stale public builds, or log-only proof
v7_target.proof_rule: every action, ask, or decline must cite current surface-readable proof from the public build and the visible user surface

primary_user_input.reason: This exercises the text transcript upload path without making live microphone permission or generated audio a prerequisite.

real_user_surfaces.name: Anticipy public app
proof_needed: current public app URL or visible app state
paired installed user-device engine status if available
current installer or build identity when surfaced by the product

real_user_surfaces.name: Canva
real_user_surfaces.surface: Canva design editor in the user's actual signed-in Chrome profile
proof_needed: visible Chrome URL/title or DOM/screenshot showing canva.com and a current design editor, visible Canva sign-in, or readable missing-design state
surface-readable evidence for the Solace Studio spring pop-up design or the absence of a matching readable design
before/after proof if Anticipy adds a Canva comment or text note

moments.instruction: Start from the public app path, use the public account/onboarding/download flow if needed, and confirm that the installed user-device engine is the runtime handling the input.
proof_expected: installed user-device engine pairing or status surface
current build or installer identity when surfaced by the product

moments.surface: Canva design editor in real visible Chrome
moments.instruction: Attach to or open the user's actual Chrome profile with session preservation and inspect only the visible Canva state. If Canva is not signed in, no design is visible, or the requested Solace Studio design cannot be read, leave Canva unchanged and require Anticipy to ask or decline with that surface proof.
valid_surface_examples: canva.com design editor already visible in Chrome
Canva sign-in screen visible in Chrome
Canva projects or search results visible in Chrome
invalid_surface_examples: service response without a visible Canva surface

moments.transcript_reference_text: In the Canva flyer I already have open for Solace Studio's spring pop-up, add a small comment near the Early Bird tile saying: Sponsor logo deadline Friday 2 PM. If you cannot verify the real Canva surface is open and editable, ask me before changing anything.
moments.delivery_instruction: Deliver this through the product's transcript paste/upload path, preferring a text-file upload when the product exposes it. Do not use MP3 upload or live microphone capture for the primary input.
proof_expected: transcript upload or paste/upload route receives the exact text bytes
fresh transcript ingest id or equivalent transcript-upload receipt
normalized input record with source_mode transcript_upload and source_detail text_file
same account and device identity as the installed user-device engine

moments.instruction: Show that the uploaded text transcript enters the same normalized inference boundary used by MP3/audio upload, computer microphone, and external microphone inputs.
proof_expected: anticipy.normalized_input.v7 or equivalent normalized input artifact
same downstream inference event shape as audio and microphone input modes
no separate Canva decision branch for transcript upload
proof_gap_to_expose: missing public installed user-device engine pairing proof

moments.instruction: Choose exactly one decision after reading the transcript upload and the real Canva surface.

acceptable_outcomes.when: A real visible Canva design for Solace Studio's spring pop-up is already signed in, editable, and the Early Bird area is surface-readable.
required_proof: Canva comment or text-note surface after action
decision artifact tied to the transcript-upload normalized input

acceptable_outcomes.when: Canva is signed in but the matching design, Early Bird area, or edit target needs user confirmation.
required_proof: visible Canva ambiguity or missing target evidence

acceptable_outcomes.when: Canva is not signed in, the design surface is unreadable, permissions are missing, or the product cannot verify it is using the real Chrome user surface.
required_proof: visible Canva sign-in, missing permission, or unreadable-surface evidence

unacceptable_outcomes: claiming a Canva edit without a current visible Canva surface
using audio upload or live microphone as the delivered primary input
using a copied Chrome profile or hidden browser for Canva proof
replacing Canva proof with a generic browser note

moments.instruction: After the primary transcript upload path is delivered, observe whether the public product exposes MP3/audio upload, computer microphone, and external microphone selection controls. Record visible gaps, but do not replace the transcript-upload input with those modes.
proof_expected: visible MP3/audio upload control or missing-control state
visible computer microphone permission or selected-device state if present
visible external microphone selection or missing-device state if present
no fake receipts accepted for any input-mode claim

success_criteria: persona_uuid matches the UUID directory and persona.json uuid
transcript upload is the delivered primary input
the uploaded text transcript reaches the same normalized inference pipeline as audio and microphone modes
Canva is the hard-category surface and is read through real visible Chrome
Anticipy records act, ask, or decline with surface-readable proof from the current public build
failure_triggers: primary input is MP3/audio upload, live mic, computer microphone, or external microphone
Canva proof is replaced by a generic browser note or non-user surface
Chrome proof comes from a cloned profile or hidden browser
decision proof relies on logs without visible surface evidence
product uses a private build or source checkout as the user-device engine
input-mode parity is claimed without normalized input or inference artifacts
